title: Cutting AI agent cloud costs by 87% with isolated Orbits & sub-minute circuit breakers

heroAlt: VM Nebula Orbit architecture with Pulsar metering and Stasis circuit breaker.
html:
Why autonomous agents burn runaway cloud budgets, and how VM Nebula enforces Pulsar metering and 60-second Stasis cutoffs across GCP and Azure AI Foundry.

The Problem in Production

Every architecture decision in ARCHITECTURE · VM NEBULA came from real production constraints: either an asyncio event loop deadlocking under cluster load, a runaway token bill crossing thousands of dollars, or a wholesale merchant needing sub-second Urdu/Pashto voice billing.

How We Engineered the Fix

By fixing the owning layer directly, adding deterministic regression suites, and verifying exact bytes in production, we turned fragile prototypes into durable production systems.
